description: Use when the user gives an EU VAT number and you need to know if it is valid: live check in the European Commission's VIES service for all 27 member states plus Northern Ireland, with the registered company name and address where shared. Input: VAT number with country prefix, e.g. IE6388047V. Costs 0.003 USDC via x402, or 2 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed

vat.description: EU VAT number with country prefix, e.g. IE6388047V
